title: Code On The Go's Addons Manager, installing the plugin
key: Install the plugin.
how: In Code On The Go, open the Addons Manager, and choose the Share Your Apps .cgp file. Capture the screen that asks to install it.

title: The Store section
key: The store's name, at the top of its page.
An optional description, in HTML.
Change the header picture or video, or Default for the built-in one.
An optional PIN, of up to 6 digits.
how: Open the Share Your Apps tab, and scroll to the top. Fill in a name, a description and a PIN, so each field shows something.

title: A description with an HTML problem
key: The warning: here, a bold tag that's never closed. It won't stop a publish, but may spoil the page.
how:
In the store description, type

Hello world

, leaving the unclosed. Capture the red warning under the field.

title: The product list
key: Add a product.
A product in the store, with what buyers can download: here, its source. Tap it to open it.
draft: not published: nothing to download, so it's left out.
how: In the Share Your Apps tab, scroll to Products, with at least two products, one of them a draft: no APK chosen, and Publish the source unticked.

title: A product's name, project and APK
key: The name buyers see.
The Code On The Go project it comes from.
The APK buyers download.
What buyers can download: the app, its source, or both.
how: Open a product, and scroll to its top: its name, project, APK and the two checkboxes.

title: Choosing an APK, with an unsigned build
key: A signed build: choose this kind.
An unsigned build, marked: buyers can't install it.
how: Build a project that has no release signing with assembleDebug and assembleRelease, so it has app-debug.apk and app-release-unsigned.apk. In a product using that project, tap Choose beside APK. Two builds are enough: one signed, one unsigned.

title: Pictures and video
key: The pictures and video, by file name.
Describe: say what it shows, and, for a video, add captions.
Remove it from the product.
Add pictures, videos or sounds.
how: Open a product with two pictures and a video, one picture described and the video with captions.

title: Describing a picture
key: What to write.
The description, which screen readers read aloud in place of the picture.
how: Tap Describe beside a picture, and type a description, before tapping Save.

title: Captions for a video
key: The captions file chosen.
Choose a WebVTT captions file, ending .vtt.
Remove the captions.
how: Tap Describe beside a video, then Choose captions file, and pick a .vtt file.

title: A product's description, order and removal
key: What buyers read about it, in HTML.
Optional details: whatsNew, license, author and website.
Move up and Move down set the order buyers see.
Remove the product, after asking.
how: Open a product, and scroll to its end: description, Extra JSON, and the three buttons.

title: Confirming a publish
key: How many products the store will have.
Any left out, and why.
how: Tap Publish, and capture the dialog before choosing.

title: Android asking to allow installing apps
key: Open Settings, and allow Code On The Go to install apps. Needed once, for Local Store Server.
how: On a phone where Code On The Go has never installed an app, publish for the first time, and capture Android's prompt.

title: A finished publish
key: The result: Published … files verified, then any left out, and any notes.
how: Publish, and capture the bottom of the tab when it finishes, with at least one product left out.

title: A publish that couldn't finish
key: What went wrong. Nothing changed: buyers keep the previous store.
how: Move a product's chosen APK away, then publish, and capture the red message.

title: Templates and Extra JSON
key: Your own template, or empty for the built-in one.
Choose a template file, such as an alternative.
Start from the built-in template, or go back to it.
Settings for the whole store: an announcement, a colour, the page's language.
how: In the Share Your Apps tab, scroll to Advanced, with a template and Extra JSON filled in.

title: Long-press help, in the Share Your Apps tab
key: A short explanation, after long-pressing a heading. Code On The Go adds a note that it comes from a plugin.
+ See more, for detail and a help page.
how: Long-press the PIN (optional) heading. Code On The Go draws this: capture its real look.

title: Manage server, serving
key: What the server is doing, and which store.
The store's address. The button beside it copies it.
The codes buyers scan.
What Start will serve.
how: Open Local Store Server while it serves your store, and capture the top of Manage server.

title: Storage access still needed
key: Tap it and allow access, once: the server needs it to read your store's files.
how: Before allowing All files access to Local Store Server, open it. (Or turn the access off in Android's Settings, capture, then turn it on again.)

title: The Server panel
key: The port, the number in the store's address. Its label has help; the field keeps its long-press for text.
Start serving.
Stop serving.
The help pages.
how: In Manage server, capture the Server panel.

title: The codes buyers scan, on a hotspot
key: The first code joins buyers to the hotspot.
The second opens the store.
The tip for a buyer whose phone can't open it.
how: Turn Wi-Fi off, tap Start, then Show QR codes for buyers. Capture the whole screen, scrolling if needed.

title: Making a join code for ordinary Wi-Fi
key: What this is for: making a code that joins buyers to your Wi-Fi.
The network's password, never saved.
Show the code.
how: On ordinary Wi-Fi, open Show QR codes for buyers, and capture the part asking for the network's password.

section: The Wi-Fi Direct hotspot's name and password
title: The Wi-Fi Direct hotspot panel
key: Its name, after DIRECT-LS-.
Its password, 8 to 63 characters.
Keep them, for the next time the hotspot starts.
Fill in a strong password.
how: In Manage server, capture the Wi-Fi Direct hotspot panel.

title: When to run
key: Keep serving whatever the screen does.
Save battery: pause when the screen turns off, and resume on unlocking.
how: In Manage server, capture the When to run panel.

section: Sharing your store with another seller
title: Starting a share
key: Share a copy of your store, while it serves.
how: While your store serves, capture the Copies of this store panel.

section: Sharing your store with another seller
title: The share code
key: The large code: the other phone scans it to import.
Or the other phone types this code; the icon copies it.
One phone, for 10 minutes.
For a phone without the app: a small code, or a link to open in its browser, with a button that copies it, to download Local Store Server from this phone.
how: Tap Share this store…, and capture the whole screen, scrolling if needed.

section: Sharing your store with another seller
title: Allowing a copy
key: These four digits must match the other phone's.
When their copy expires.
Deny, if the digits don't match.
Allow, if they do.
how: With a second phone importing, capture the Allow a copy? screen, before choosing.

title: The Import a store panel
key: Serve a copy of someone else's store, with their permission.
Start importing. It's disabled, saying why, while the phone serves a store.
how: With the server stopped, capture the Import a store panel.

title: The Logs panel
key: How large each log file grows; 0 turns logging off.
Read the logs, newest first.
Send the log files off the phone.
how: In Manage server, capture the Logs panel.

title: A tooltip
key: A short explanation, after long-pressing Start.
+ See more, for more.
how: In Manage server, long-press the START button, and capture the tooltip.

title: After + See more
key: The short explanation, and more.
The help page, opening at this topic.
how: Long-press the START button, tap + See more, and capture the tooltip.

title: A help page
how: Long-press the START button, tap + See more, then tap Serving the store, and capture the page.
key: The section the button opened: here, Start, Stop and the port. Scroll for the rest of the page.

title: Downloading the app
key: Download anyway. Browsers warn about any app from outside the Play Store.
how: On the second phone, scan the owner's small QR code with the camera, open the link, and capture the browser's download prompt.

title: Starting an import
key: Tap Import a store….
how: On a phone with Local Store Server but no store, open Manage server.

title: The code, and your phone's name
key: The owner's code, filled in from their QR code, or typed.
What the owner sees.
Ask for the copy.
how: Tap Import a store…, type a code, and capture the screen before tapping Continue.

title: The four digits, then its progress
key: These digits must match the owner's screen.
Its progress: here, waiting for the owner to allow it.
how: After Continue, and the owner allowing it, capture the screen while it receives the store.

title: Imported
key: Shown only if you joined the owner's hotspot: leave it first.
Start serving the store.
how: Import over the owner's hotspot, and capture the last screen.

title: If it stops partway
key: Try again, while the owner's phone still shows the code.
how: Start an import, turn Wi-Fi off on the second phone partway, then on, and capture the screen.

section: A PIN, if you want one
title: Your copy, and its PIN
key: Serve it, with the PIN below.
Your own PIN, or none.
Remove it from this phone.
how: With a copy imported and not serving, capture the store's panel in Manage server.

title: The codes, for your buyers
key: Show the codes people scan.
how: While serving the copy, capture the top of Manage server.

title: After the store expires
key: Close the notice.
how: After a copy's date has passed, open Manage server. To see it sooner, import with In a week, then move the phone's date 8 days ahead; turn automatic date and time back on afterwards.

title: The store, in a buyer's browser
how: Not captured on a phone: the demo store, published with the plugin's code and served with the server's code, then shown in a phone-sized browser.
key: Accessible version: the same store, plain and in large text.
The store's name and description.
Download APK: download the app.

title: A product, with pictures
how: Not captured on a phone: the demo store, published with the plugin's code and served with the server's code, then shown in a phone-sized browser.
key: The product's pictures and videos: swipe, or tap the arrow.
What the app is, and which version.
Download APK.
Which phones this version is for.

title: The accessible version
how: Not captured on a phone: the demo store, published with the plugin's code and served with the server's code, then shown in a phone-sized browser.
key: Standard version: back to the usual page.
Every app, as a list.
